name: Prince Edward Island
description: A low, gently rolling island of red sandstone soils, farmland and beaches in the Gulf of St. Lawrence; the highest point is 142 m. Coastal erosion and storm surge are the dominant physical hazards (provincial source not retrievable on 2026-10-30).
